## Summary

Describe the change and why it improves Portable AI Memory.

- [ ] Skill workflow
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Template

## Privacy and safety

- [ ] No real personal data, chat exports, or private project documents are included.

- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated.
